endpoint.cost_basis: institutional endpoint; provider-billed token price unavailable

corpus.note: Retain Main, Validation, and Extension labels in every cell; headline analysis pools all 110 instances, with split-specific sensitivity analysis when substantively informative.

retrieval.note: Candidate sets are prebuilt frozen workspace inputs; retrieval is not rerun during a batch.

m4_repair_controller.repair_budget_scope: all repair completions, including parse-seed repairs
m4_repair_controller.candidate_selection: lexicographic public-gate rank: overall pass, consecutive passed prefix G0..G6, total passed gates, fewer diagnostics
m4_repair_controller.diagnostic_memory: up to 60 unique public diagnostics across prior states
m4_repair_controller.regressions: audited but never replace a better candidate

m5.service_access: setting-scoped catalog, contract, policy, and public-fixture access
m5.hidden_gate_policy: G6 is evaluation-only and never returned to the agent

scoring.empty_wiring_policy: not_applicable when both gold and submission have no producer-consumer pairs

design.formula: 110 instances x 1 model x 6 methods x 3 seeds
design.primary_unit: model x method x split x instance x seed

notes: Frozen after the five-instance M5 checkpoint achieved 100% operational coverage, public-validator use in every run, no infrastructure failures, and declared-budget stopping behavior.
SINTEF v19 supersedes candidate v18 after its M5 trace exposed a missing public schema bundle in the isolated agent image.
The M5 image now installs the repository-level public JSON schemas at the compiler's runtime schema location; compilation is smoke-tested inside the image before any provider-backed pilot.
M5 receives the same setting-scoped public inputs and at most four public validator calls as M4; G6 remains hidden until final evaluation.
The fixed M5 control limits are 12 agent steps, 750000 cumulative tokens, and 1800 seconds. All model calls, tool calls, validator calls, steps, and stopping reasons are recorded.
M5 uses each model's declared context window rather than an M5-specific smaller window.
The SINTEF endpoint admits one concurrent completion, so cells run sequentially while methods are interleaved within instance and seed order.
Pilot M5 on one and then five Main instances before freezing or opening Validation-20.
